summary: PTC Therapeutics filed an 8-K announcing the pricing of a $500M 0.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2031 offering, with an underwriter option for an additional $50M. Concurrently, PTC will use ~$328.8M of net proceeds to repurchase $222M of its outstanding 1.5% Convertible Senior Notes due 2026 in privately negotiated transactions. Remaining proceeds go to general corporate purposes and potential additional repurchases. The notes are unregistered and convertible. The offering is not contingent on the repurchases. Watch for execution of the concurrent note repurchases and any follow-on actions to manage maturities.
